Corrected historical calendars, retrospective availability, back-adjusted benchmarks, overlapping modes/windows and shared shocks remain. No executable fills, costs, stops, targets, uncertainty inference or independent holdout is tested.

nextTest.description: Freeze one instrument/calendar/horizon before any new observations, for example 6E U.S.-only H5, with confirmed pre-release EMA timing, a same-release unconditional benchmark, executable next price, fixed exit and measured news costs.
